name: OnTick(string symbol)
summary: This is a multicurrency event handler template that extends the standard OnTick() to receive tick events for multiple symbols simultaneously. It does not implement any trading logic itself, serving as a framework for building multicurrency EAs.
summary_zh: 这是一个多货币事件处理器模板，扩展了标准OnTick()以同时接收多个交易品种的tick事件。它本身不实现任何交易逻辑，作为构建多货币EA的框架使用。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个多货币事件处理框架模板。它通过自定义的OnTick(string symbol)事件处理器替代标准的OnTick()函数，使得EA能够同时监听多个交易品种的tick事件。交易品种列表通过SYMBOLS_TRADING宏定义配置，支持手动指定品种列表或使用Market Watch中所有品种。事件类型通过CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL宏定义为CHARTEVENT_TICK，表示监听tick级别的事件。核心逻辑封装在包含文件OnTick(string symbol).mqh中，模板本身仅提供架构骨架，不包含任何入场、出场、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑。用户需要在此基础上自行添加交易策略代码。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a multicurrency event handling framework template. It replaces the standard OnTick() function with a custom OnTick(string symbol) event handler, enabling the EA to listen to tick events from multiple symbols simultaneously. The symbol list is configured via the SYMBOLS_TRADING macro definition, supporting either a manually specified list or all symbols from Market Watch. The event type is defined as CHARTEVENT_TICK via the CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL macro, indicating tick-level event monitoring. The core logic is encapsulated in the include file OnTick(string symbol).mqh, and the template itself only provides an architectural skeleton without any entry, exit, position sizing, or money management logic. Users must add their own trading strategy code on top of this framework.

parameters.name: SYMBOLS_TRADING
parameters.description: 多货币监听的交易品种列表，也可设为MARKET_WATCH使用市场观察窗口中所有品种
parameters.description_en: Multi-symbol list; MARKET_WATCH uses all Watch symbols

parameters.name: CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL
parameters.description: OnTick(string symbol)事件处理器的自定义事件类型，需对应ENUM_CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL枚举
parameters.description_en: Custom event type for OnTick(symbol), maps to ENUM_CHART_EVENT_SYMBOL

pros: 提供多货币事件处理框架，解决标准OnTick()只能监听当前图表品种的局限性
支持灵活的品种配置方式，既可手动指定也可自动读取Market Watch
模板结构清晰，有详细注释说明配置步骤和使用方法
pros_en: Provides a multicurrency event handling framework that overcomes the limitation of standard OnTick() which only monitors the current chart symbol
Supports flexible symbol configuration - both manual specification and automatic Market Watch reading
Template structure is clear with detailed comments explaining configuration steps and usage
cons: 仅是框架模板，不包含任何实际交易逻辑，实用性取决于用户的二次开发能力
核心实现依赖外部包含文件OnTick(string symbol).mqh，无法独立评估完整机制
缺少错误处理和边界情况考虑，如品种不存在或Market Watch为空时的处理
cons_en: Only a framework template with no actual trading logic; utility depends entirely on user's secondary development capability
Core implementation relies on the external include file OnTick(string symbol).mqh, making it impossible to independently evaluate the complete mechanism
Lacks error handling and edge case considerations, such as handling non-existent symbols or empty Market Watch
improvements: 增加品种有效性验证和Market Watch为空时的错误提示机制
在模板中添加示例交易逻辑注释，帮助用户更快理解如何在此基础上构建策略
improvements_en: Add symbol validity verification and error prompts when Market Watch is empty
Include example trading logic comments in the template to help users quickly understand how to build strategies on top of this framework

risk_points: 模板本身不执行任何交易操作，无直接风险
多货币监听可能增加系统资源消耗，在大量品种同时活跃时需注意性能
risk_points_en: The template itself does not execute any trading operations, posing no direct risk
Multicurrency monitoring may increase system resource consumption; performance should be monitored with many active symbols

summary_en: This is a multicurrency event handler template that extends the standard OnTick() to receive tick events for multiple symbols simultaneously. It does not implement any trading logic itself, serving as a framework for building multicurrency EAs.
